problem_statement: TCP socket input callbacks can request that an unconsumed suffix remain buffered, but those bytes are lost or overwritten when more data arrives. Retained bytes must be presented in order together with subsequent data, including when a single incoming segment exceeds the input buffer size. A newly registered socket must start with no retained data. Requests to retain more bytes than were delivered must stay bounded, and receiving more data while the buffer is entirely retained must return without overwriting it or looping indefinitely. Preserve ordinary reception, binary payloads, callbacks that consume all data, sockets without input callbacks, and send-queue behavior.
orientation: Focused host component tests compile the real TCP socket, Contiki process dispatcher, and list library. uIP events and transport boundaries are scripted; no TCP socket implementation is replaced. Run `run_tests`, optionally with regression or control. Existing upstream data-structure tests provide additional controls. Tests under tests/ are protected.
